title: Every screen outside the panes looks like an app, not a terminal
notes: Restyle and relayout all chrome (tabs in the title row, bottom status bar with a mode switcher, board lanes, dialogs, settings, command, notes, which-key) with lucide icons and a system font. Terminal and nvim panes untouched.

comments.body: PR #72: tabs in the title row, a status bar at the foot with a view switch, board lanes and raised cards, one dialog sheet with keycaps and search, Lucide icons throughout. index.css split into chrome, board, dialogs and which-key stylesheets. Panes and keys unchanged. v1.11.0.
